newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippines 9-mth agriculture growth at 4.17 pct.
newsitem.headline: Philippines 9-mth agriculture growth at 4.17 pct.

text.p: The Philippines' agricultural sector grew by 4.17 percent in the first nine months of the year, the Department of Agriculture said on Tuesday.
The agriculture department said at constant prices, gross value of agricultural output for the first nine months amounted to 165.9 billion pesos, up by 4.17 percent.
At current prices, the gross value of agricultural production amounted to 353.3 billion pesos, up by 17.84 percent from the 1995 level.

The department said in a report that improvement in the crops subsector, sugarcane, hog and chicken industries led to the growth in the agricultural sector despite declining outputs of the coconut and fishery industries.
Production in the crops subsector expanded by 5 percent with gross value of 198.4 billion pesos. Unmilled rice posted a 15.71 percent output increase while corn production fell by 2.19 percent.

Livestock production rose by 6.68 percent with gross receipts at current prices reaching 55.6 billion pesos or 12.79 percent higher than 1995 level. The agriculture department said the hog industry was the major source of growth in the livestock subsector.
The poultry subsector posted a 10.98 percent growth with gross value at 39.4 billion pesos.
The gross output of the fishery subsector dropped by 3.30 percent with production valued at 59.9 billion pesos at current prices, up by 0.76 percent from last year's level.
The poultry subsector posted growth of 10.98 percent with gross value at 39.4 billion pesos.
The gross output of the fishery subsector dropped by 3.3 percent with production valued at 59.9 billion pesos at current prices, up 0.76 percent from last year's level. ($1 = 26.3 pesos)
